name: custom-plugin-game-developer
title: 🎮 Complete Game Developer Plugin - Master Game Development
description: Comprehensive game development learning system with 7 specialized agents, 21 in-depth skills, 4 slash commands, and automation hooks. Master game design, programming, graphics, audio, networking, tools, and publishing across Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot.

agents.name: 🎨 Game Designer Agent
agents.description: Expert in game design, mechanics, level design, player experience, and game balance. Creates engaging gameplay and defines game vision.

agents.name: 💻 Game Programmer Agent
agents.description: Specialist in C#/C++ game programming, engine systems, gameplay systems, architecture patterns, and code optimization.

agents.name: 🖼️ Graphics & Rendering Agent
agents.description: Expert in 3D graphics, shader programming, VFX systems, lighting design, and rendering optimization for visual excellence.

agents.name: 🎵 Audio & Sound Design Agent
agents.description: Specialist in game audio, music composition, spatial audio, voice systems, and immersive soundscapes.

agents.name: 🌐 Networking & Multiplayer Agent
agents.description: Expert in multiplayer systems, netcode, server architecture, synchronization algorithms, and scalable game backends.

agents.name: ⚙️ Tools & Pipeline Agent
agents.description: Specialist in game development tools, asset pipelines, build automation, CI/CD systems, and team workflows.

agents.name: 🚀 Game Publishing Agent
agents.description: Expert in game publishing, platform requirements, monetization strategies, marketing, and live operations.
